_comment: Captured 2026-09-04 from real devices with `avahi-browse -rtp _elg._tcp` (avahi-daemon, wired iface eth0); addresses resolved with `avahi-resolve -n` / `avahi-resolve -6 -n`. Structure and record shape are verbatim; serials, MACs, names, hostnames and addresses are synthetic. Service type is _elg._tcp.local.

services.notes: txt.id equals accessory-info.macAddress on this device.
txt.id (01:C4:63:00:00:02) does NOT equal accessory-info.macAddress (3C:6A:9D:00:00:02). Do not treat txt.id as a MAC or as a stable device key; use accessory-info.serialNumber instead.
